title: Planned 2027 Litter
subtitle: Boaz of Covenant Working Dogs x Aurora vom Norden
paragraphs: The plan for 2027 spring/summer is to breed Aurora to International Champion Boaz of Covenant Working Dogs AS/BCAT/BH-VT/CSAU/DE/DMX/FN/FD/HDJ/IGP1.  Boaz does have a recessive fawn allele so puppies from this litter can be brindle or fawn, also flashy or plain.
